name: SkySelect
category: AOG support: parts, rotables and technicians
summary: AI procurement platform that matches part requests to suppliers across thousands of vendors and automates quoting through PO. It raised $9 million in March 2026, reports more than $6 billion in transactions processed, and lists JetBlue, Sun Country Airlines, ATSG, Wideroe and Vueling among recent clients.

whyItMatters: A vendor-neutral way to cut both AOG chase time and safety stock. Compare its recommendations against your buyers' picks on last quarter's AOG buys before you switch workflows.
